question.text: Roshni Trust reports negative feedback from 8% of beneficiaries interviewed. Management wants to omit this from the SIR. As the SIA, which is the CORRECT response per Chapter 7.3.2?

answer.text: Record internally but not in the SIR
Report negative impacts along with positive ones, including recommendations/modifications to reduce adverse effects in the future

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.3.2 states: 'Along with positive changes or effects, it is crucial to report even negative impacts of the social interventions in order to reduce the adverse effect in the future. It can include future recommendations or modifications based on the same.' Option D follows this guidance directly. The Trap: A is the classic suppression-of-bad-news trap and directly contradicts the chapter. B violates the same transparency requirement by withholding adverse findings from the SIR. C invents a 50% threshold not found in the source. Note: Structure every SIR with a 'What did not work' section per programme so adverse findings and proposed modifications are disclosed alongside positive changes.
